item.text: {"search_note":"I found more evidence of implementation than of pure symbolism, so the negative side is mostly about incomplete results and political distraction, not total absence of action. I did not find strong direct evidence that Kishida was merely making propaganda in 2024. The best counterevidence is outcome-based: weak wages, weak yen pressure, and criticism that rhetoric outpaced some policy reality.
